roles/resourcemanager.editor.title: Resource Manager Editor
roles/resourcemanager.editor.desc: Access to manage Resource Manager resources

roles/resourcemanager.folderAdmin.title: Folder Admin
roles/resourcemanager.folderAdmin.desc: Provides all available permissions for working with folders.

roles/resourcemanager.folderCreator.title: Folder Creator
roles/resourcemanager.folderCreator.desc: Provides permissions needed to browse the hierarchy and create folders.

roles/resourcemanager.folderEditor.title: Folder Editor
roles/resourcemanager.folderEditor.desc: Provides permission to modify folders as well as to view a folder's allow policy.

roles/resourcemanager.folderIamAdmin.title: Folder IAM Admin
roles/resourcemanager.folderIamAdmin.desc: Provides permissions to administer allow policies on folders.

roles/resourcemanager.folderMover.title: Folder Mover
roles/resourcemanager.folderMover.desc: Provides permission to move projects and folders into and out of a parent organization or folder.

roles/resourcemanager.folderViewer.title: Folder Viewer
roles/resourcemanager.folderViewer.desc: Provides permission to get a folder and list the folders and projects below a resource.

roles/resourcemanager.lienModifier.title: Project Lien Modifier
roles/resourcemanager.lienModifier.desc: Provides access to modify Liens on projects.

roles/resourcemanager.organizationAdmin.title: Organization Administrator
roles/resourcemanager.organizationAdmin.desc: Access to manage IAM policies and view organization policies for organizations, folders, and projects.

roles/resourcemanager.organizationViewer.title: Organization Viewer
roles/resourcemanager.organizationViewer.desc: Provides access to view an organization.

roles/resourcemanager.projectCreator.title: Project Creator
roles/resourcemanager.projectCreator.desc: Provides access to create new projects. Once a user creates a project, they're automatically granted the owner role for that project.

roles/resourcemanager.projectDeleter.title: Project Deleter
roles/resourcemanager.projectDeleter.desc: Provides access to delete Google Cloud projects.

roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin.title: Project IAM Admin
roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin.desc: Provides permissions to administer allow policies on projects.

roles/resourcemanager.projectMover.title: Project Mover
roles/resourcemanager.projectMover.desc: Provides access to update and move projects.

roles/resourcemanager.tagAdmin.title: Tag Administrator
roles/resourcemanager.tagAdmin.desc: Access to create, delete, update, and manage access to Tags

roles/resourcemanager.tagHoldAdmin.title: Tag Hold Administrator
roles/resourcemanager.tagHoldAdmin.desc: Access to create, delete and list TagHolds under a TagValue

roles/resourcemanager.tagUser.title: Tag User
roles/resourcemanager.tagUser.desc: Access to list Tags and manage their associations with resources

roles/resourcemanager.tagViewer.title: Tag Viewer
roles/resourcemanager.tagViewer.desc: Access to list Tags and their associations with resources

roles/resourcemanager.viewer.title: Resource Manager Viewer
roles/resourcemanager.viewer.desc: Access to view Resource Manager resources
